snippet.title: Digimon ReArise (Android Trailer)
snippet.description:
Trailer of the upcoming Android game Digimon ReArise.

Pre-registration: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.bandainamcoent.digimon_rearise_ww

Release is set for October 21st.
